dct_description_sm: This inventory represents the French contribution to  EDMED (European Directory of Marine Environmental Data)   accessible via  SeaDataNet/sea-search portal, with the following objectives of : identifying the data sources, useful to engineers, scientiists, students, stake holders; facilitating the communication of informaton and data between scientists; provinding an information system for the ocean surveillance and monitoring.
dct_title_s: French national oceanographic data center, Nautilus Portal
